name: @deepseek-ai/dsh-desktop
description: Desktop shell for DeepSeek Harness: Electron main process supervising a local dsh web child process

scripts.package:mac: node scripts/verify-target.mjs darwin && npm run stage && electron-builder --mac
scripts.package:mac:arm64: node scripts/verify-target.mjs darwin arm64 && npm run stage && electron-builder --mac --arm64
scripts.package:mac:x64: node scripts/verify-target.mjs darwin x64 && npm run stage && electron-builder --mac --x64
scripts.package:win: node scripts/verify-target.mjs win32 x64 && npm run stage && electron-builder --win --x64
scripts.package:linux: node scripts/verify-target.mjs linux x64 && npm run stage && electron-builder --linux --x64
